newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker firm on on tight supplies worries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker firm on on tight supplies worries.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were firm on Wednesday amid tight supplies for the 180-cst grade, traders said.

Prices were also supported after South Korea raised bunker prices by $2 per tonne also amid tight supplies, but some traders said the impact was mainly psychological. "The $2 difference does not mean much to shipowners," said one trader.

Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $105-$106 per tonne and 380-cst at around $100, around Tuesday's levels. MDO and gas oil were quoted at around $195 and $213 respectively, slightly firmer than day-earlier $193/$195 and $207/$210.
